findings.issue: Piel infinitive construct (לְפַלֵּא) is rendered as the adjective extraordinario, so the verbal act on the vow becomes a quality of the noun.
Masculine plural offering noun שְׁלָמִים is rendered as the non-word pazes, which only echoes paz and does not convey the offering.

notes: Y cuando, hagas (2ms), hijo de ganado, holocausto o sacrificio, and a Jehová match the remaining tokens.
